families: npc soldier (401/403/407/409 graphics/people/soldier/c10w*, walk; Milder Flatstomp in s1-bul and town scripts)
sprite_reading: Verified on tools/dinkex/out/sprites/401-409: auburn-brown short hair, large steel pauldrons, steel forearms and lower legs, brown tabard with a diagonal strap and a belt, a silver skirt to mid-thigh, tan thighs, dark blue cowl at the neck, skin-coloured upper arms. The sprite's grey hands (gauntlets) are not reproduced.

third_party.use: plate armour scratch normal and roughness, recoloured

third_party.asset_id: base mesh head/hands/shoulder yoke (shipped fit) + CC0_BaseMesh.obj arm faces, young_caucasian_male skin albedo, eyebrow001, eyelashes01
third_party.use: head and hand topology with shipped weights; bare arms re-fitted from the base mesh and welded to hands and shoulders; albedo base; brow and lash cards

authored_here: all armour, straps, buckles, tabard, cowl, hose, boots; riveted-mail tile (Tools/mail_tex.py, numpy) and the mail skirt with authored skinning; hair cards and strand atlas; eyes; skin authoring; all bakes
importer_changes: New asset name SK_Milder_Photoreal (4 LOD FBX in Milder/Export). Same 89-bone SK_Mannequin skeleton, bone names, hierarchy and rest pose as the shipped SK_Milder; existing clips apply unchanged. No actions are embedded (the shipped candidate has none either).

Material slots change from [MI_Milder_Skin, MI_Milder_Eyes, MI_Milder_Hair, MI_Milder_BrowLash, MI_Milder_Wardrobe] to [MI_Milder_PR_Skin, MI_Milder_PR_Eyes, MI_Milder_PR_Hair, MI_Milder_PR_Outfit, MI_Milder_PR_Gear]: still five slots, same convention as SK_Dink_Photoreal (brows/lashes are cards inside the Hair slot; wardrobe split into Outfit 4K and Gear 2K).

Each slot has its own BC/N/ORM set; Hair is masked/two-sided with alpha in BC; Gear uses ORM.B metallic; Skin has an extra SSS map (rgb scatter colour x thickness). Normal maps are OpenGL (+Y): keep normal_flip_green true.
Textures: Skin 4096, Outfit 4096, Gear 2048, Hair 2048, Eyes 1024.

Skin weights: head and hands keep the shipped weights; the new bare-arm skin and all garments take weights by surface transfer from the Manny reference (used transiently, not delivered), as the shipped candidates did; skirts carry authored pelvis/thigh/calf weights; plates and buckles are rigid on one or two bones.
A Physics Asset still has to be generated in Unreal. UV uniqueness is per slot (see uv_per_slot); the validator's whole-mesh UV_OVERLAP error is expected with five texture sets.
review_renders: Review/r4_skirt.png (walk pose pair from two sides, turn front/back)
budget_note: LOD0 34.6k triangles: over the 20k soft target, just under the 35k hard cap. Head 8.6k (MakeHuman topology), hands thinned to about a third, bare arms and shoulders 2k, hair about 4k, armour and clothing about 17k.
known_weaknesses: Not photoreal at 1 m; reads as an armoured young man at gameplay distance. Last review round (r4) still faulted everything below.

Back view: the sleeveless tabard's armhole edges are ragged behind the pauldrons and show jagged slivers of shoulder skin; a rectangular bake artefact (striped patch about 8 cm wide) sits on the back of the mail skirt left of centre; a few brown tabard specks come through the lower edge of the blue cowl.
Hands are bare: the sprite's grey gauntlets are not built (fingers need the shipped hand skin). Elbow cops are not built either.

Plate: pauldron dome with two lames, vambraces, greaves and knee cops are parametric shells with rolled edges, dents and a tooled border in the bake, but no rivets, no articulation and single-sided (thickness lips only); the knee cop is rigid on calf/thigh and will separate from the leg in a deep knee bend. The knee strap was dropped for budget, so the cop has no visible attachment; pauldron lames show one arm strap with buckle only.
Straps and buckles: ring straps lie on the plates and each carries a small iron buckle, but the buckles are 3-sided tubes and the strap does not thread through them.

Mail skirt is a textured shell (authored ring tile baked to normal/roughness/metal), no ring silhouette or alpha at the hem; weights are authored pelvis/thigh and were only checked by eye in the walk pair and turn (r4_skirt), not numerically.

Face: built on the shipped MakeHuman male head with a heavier brow and jaw and stubble shadow; no expression shapes, so no smug look; he reads as a relative of Dink. Hair is the same short card groom at lower density, with a few stray blades at the crown.
Bare arms are re-fitted MakeHuman base-mesh faces scaled up for bulk: plausible but not strongly muscular; no veins or elbow detail.
Boots are plain soft leather under the greaves (the sprite reads as steel to the toe).

Validator: NORMALS_INCONSISTENT on 2 edges (a flipped face pair in the gear slot, not located), whole-mesh UV_OVERLAP as for Dink; LOD0 over the soft triangle target. Not imported or seen in Unreal; Physics Asset not made; no actions embedded.
